articles.headline: How Tony Leung Chiu-wai Became Hong Kong's Most Decorated — and Most Reluctant — Movie Star
articles.summary_html:
A new profile has traced how Tony Leung Chiu-wai became, by wide consensus, the most garlandedwidely honoured with awards and prizes獲獎無數 actor in Hong Kong cinema history, even though he would be the last person to say so himself. Across four decades, Leung has built a career on interior performancesacting that conveys emotion through subtle inner feeling rather than outward expression內斂的演繹 — minute shifts of the eyes, a half-finished sentence, a held breath — that let him command the screendominate attention on screen through presence alone, without needing loud or dramatic action單憑氣場主宰銀幕 without ever raising his voice. From television soap operas in the 1980s to arthouse classics and, more recently, a Marvel blockbuster, he has rarely repeated himself, yet audiences and critics alike have continued to call him unmistakably, quietly, himself.

His decades-long partnership with director Wong Kar-wai produced some of Hong Kong's most internationally admired films, including the Cannes-winning In the Mood for Love, while later roles in Ang Lee's Lust, Caution and the crime thriller Infernal Affairs showed a willingness to inhabit morally ambiguous characters that most stars would avoid for fear of tarnishing their imagedamaging one's public reputation or image損害個人形象. In 2023, Venice awarded him a lifetime achievement honouran award recognising an entire career's contribution rather than a single work終身成就獎 usually reserved for directors and veterans twice his age, a recognition that cemented his status not merely as a Hong Kong star but as one of world cinema's most respected actors.

In an industry increasingly built on self-promotiondeliberately drawing public attention to oneself in order to build fame自我宣傳 — curated social media feeds, carefully managed public appearances — Leung remains a conspicuous exception, granting few interviews and offering even fewer opinions on his own legacy. For a city whose entertainment industry has long doubled as a source of cultural soft powera country or city's influence gained through culture and reputation rather than force軟實力, his example raises a pointed question for Hong Kong's next generation of performers: whether lasting recognition is better earned through visibility, or through the patient, unglamorouslacking excitement or outward appeal; plain and unremarkable毫不亮麗 accumulation of craft.
articles.summary_zh_html:
一份最新人物專訪，追溯梁朝偉如何在廣泛共識下，成為香港電影史上獲獎最多的演員——儘管他自己絕不會這樣形容自己。在長達四十年的演藝生涯中，梁朝偉建立起一套以內斂的演繹為本的表演方式——眼神的細微轉動、一句未說完的話、一次刻意按捺的呼吸——讓他無需提高嗓子，便能單憑氣場主宰銀幕。從八十年代的電視劇集，到藝術電影經典，以至近年的一部漫威電影，他甚少重複過往的演出，但無論觀眾抑或評論家，依然異口同聲地稱他——不動聲色，卻獨一無二。

他與導演王家衛長達數十年的合作，造就了多部香港最獲國際讚譽的電影，包括在康城封帝的《花樣年華》；而他後來在李安《色，戒》及警匪片《無間道》中的角色，亦顯示他甘願飾演道德模糊的人物——這類角色，大多數明星都會因擔心損害個人形象而迴避。二零二三年，威尼斯電影節向他頒發終身成就獎——這項榮譽通常只授予年紀比他長一倍的導演或影壇老將，此舉確立了他的地位：他不僅是香港明星，更是全球影壇最受尊崇的演員之一。

在一個愈趨依賴自我宣傳的行業裡——經過精心策劃的社交媒體形象、刻意安排的公開場合——梁朝偉始終是一個明顯的例外，鮮少接受訪問，更甚少評論自己的影壇地位。對於一個娛樂產業長期兼具文化軟實力角色的城市而言，他的例子向香港新一代演員提出一個尖銳問題：持久的聲望，究竟應該靠曝光率贏得，還是靠耐心而毫不亮麗地累積演技而來？
articles.image_scene: An anonymous silhouette of a man in a dark suit walking along a red carpet outside a grand Hong Kong film-awards venue at night, flashbulbs from a crowd of photographers lighting up the scene, a row of golden trophy statuettes displayed on a table nearby, the illuminated towers of Victoria Harbour glowing behind, no readable signage or logos.

articles.headline: Hong Kong Working Carers Shun Family-Friendly Measures Amid Stigma Fears, Study Finds
articles.summary_html:
A new survey by researchers at Tung Wah College has found that many working caregivers in Hong Kong quietly avoid the very arrangements meant to help them, out of fear of being stigmatisedtreated as different or shameful because of a personal circumstance被污名化 for appearing less committed to their jobs. Among 566 working carers aged between 21 and 73 who took part, researchers found that more than half had never once used the flexible working arrangementswork schedules that can be adjusted to suit an employee's personal needs彈性工作安排 their employers formally offered, even when juggling full-time work with caring for an ageing parent, a sick spouse or a child with additional needs.

Among those who did use such measures, flexible hours proved the most popular, taken up by a third of respondents, followed by part-time work, working from home and a compressed working weeka schedule that condenses the usual working hours into fewer, longer days壓縮工作週. The payoff appeared measurable: carers who used these arrangements reported noticeably fewer depressive symptomssigns of depression, such as persistent low mood and loss of energy抑鬱症狀 and a lighter caregiving burdenthe physical, emotional and practical strain of caring for a dependent family member照顧者的負擔 than those who continued to shoulder caregiving dutiesto take on and bear responsibility for caring for someone肩負照顧責任 largely in silence, suggesting the real barrier standing between carers and relief is less about availability and more about workplace stigma.

Researchers also pointed to a structural problem layered on top of the cultural one: many support services for carers still operate only during standard office hoursthe usual 9-to-5 working schedule followed by most employers標準辦公時間, making them almost impossible for a working carer to reach without taking leave. The study's authors argue that closing this gap will require more than new policies on paper; it demands a genuine workplace culture shifta broader change in the shared attitudes and unwritten norms of a workplace職場文化轉變 that frees carers from the sense that asking for help will cost them their professional standing.
articles.summary_zh_html:
東華學院一項最新調查發現，許多在職照顧者在香港其實甚少使用原本為他們而設的支援安排，原因是他們害怕因照顧家人而顯得對工作不夠投入，擔心因此被污名化。在566名年齡介乎21至73歲的在職照顧者當中，研究人員發現超過一半人從未使用過僱主正式提供的彈性工作安排，即使他們正同時兼顧全職工作，以及照顧年邁父母、患病配偶或有特殊需要的子女。

在曾經使用相關安排的受訪者當中，彈性上班時間最受歡迎，有三分之一受訪者採用，其次依次為兼職、在家工作，以及壓縮工作週。成效似乎相當明顯：曾使用這些安排的照顧者，其抑鬱症狀明顯較少，照顧者的負擔亦較輕，相比之下，那些長期獨自默默肩負照顧責任的照顧者則情況較差，反映照顧者與支援之間真正的障礙，與資源是否存在的關係較小，反而與職場污名更有關。

研究人員亦指出一個疊加於文化問題之上的結構性困難：許多為照顧者而設的支援服務，仍然只在標準辦公時間提供，令在職照顧者幾乎無法在不請假的情況下使用。研究作者認為，要彌合這道差距，單靠紙上政策並不足夠，必須有一場真正的職場文化轉變，讓照顧者不再擔心開口求助會損害自己的職業地位。

articles.headline: Environment Chief Defends 2030 Clean Air Targets, Outlines Shift Toward Construction-Site Hydrogen Power
articles.summary_html:
Hong Kong's environment chief has defended the city's target of cutting average fine suspended particulatestiny airborne pollutant particles, commonly measured as PM2.5, that are small enough to be inhaled deep into the lungs微細懸浮粒子 to below 14 micrograms per cubic metre by 2030, describing the goal as realistic but challenging. Speaking to the government's Advisory Council on the Environment, Secretary for Environment and Ecology Tse Chin-wan said the target, set out in Hong Kong's first-ever Five-Year Development Plan, would require sustained effort given that vehicle emissionsexhaust and pollutants released into the air by cars, buses and trucks車輛排放 remain the single largest source of local air pollution.

Tse acknowledged that air quality has already improved markedly as electric vehicle adoptionthe growing use of cars and buses powered by electricity instead of petrol or diesel電動車普及 accelerates across the city, but said further gains will depend on tackling sources beyond the road. The government plans to introduce legislation next year to tighten emission standardsmake the legal limits on pollutant output stricter收緊排放標準 for marine vessels, while also exploring hydrogen-powered machineryequipment that runs on hydrogen fuel instead of diesel, producing water rather than pollutants氫能驅動機械 for use at remote construction sites where connecting to the electricity grid is difficult. Officials are separately re-examining their Scheme of Control Agreementsthe regulatory contracts that set the permitted profits and obligations of Hong Kong's power companies《管制計劃協議》 with the city's two power companies, CLP Power and HK Electric, as part of a wider push toward carbon neutrality by 2050.

The Five-Year Plan also commits Hong Kong to cutting its carbon intensitythe amount of carbon emissions produced per unit of economic output碳排放強度 by 32.5 percent by 2030, measured against 2024 levels. Green groups have broadly welcomed the direction but questioned whether voluntary industry cooperationbusinesses choosing to follow environmental guidelines without being legally forced to業界合作 will be enough without firmer enforcement, leaving officials to walk a line between ambition and what remains achievable in a city still heavily reliant on fossil fuels for power generation and shipping.
articles.summary_zh_html:
香港環保局局長為本港目標進行辯解——該目標是要在二零三零年前，將平均微細懸浮粒子（即PM2.5）濃度降至每立方米十四微克以下，並形容此目標「現實但具挑戰性」。環境及生態局局長謝展寰向政府環境諮詢委員會發言時表示，此目標訂於香港首份五年發展規劃之中，鑑於車輛排放仍是本地空氣污染的最大單一來源，達標將需要持續努力。

謝展寰承認，隨著電動車普及加快，空氣質素已明顯改善，但他表示，要取得進一步成效，仍須處理道路以外的污染源。政府計劃明年立法收緊排放標準，規管船舶排放，同時探討在難以接駁電網的偏遠建築工地，使用氫能驅動機械。當局亦正另行檢討與兩家電力公司——中電及港燈——簽訂的《管制計劃協議》，作為邁向二零五零年碳中和目標的一部分舉措。

《五年規劃》亦承諾香港在二零三零年前，將碳排放強度——即每單位經濟產出所產生的排放量——按二零二四年水平計算削減百分之三十二點五。環保團體普遍歡迎這個方向，但質疑單靠自願性的業界合作，在缺乏更嚴格執法的情況下，是否足以達標，令官員須在雄心與一個仍高度依賴化石燃料發電及航運的城市所能實現的範圍之間，取得平衡。

articles.headline: Hong Kong's 700-Year-Old Oyster Industry Goes Hi-Tech With a 'Super' Specimen
articles.summary_html:
In the fishing village of Lau Fau Shan, where families have farmed oysters for some 700 years, a centuries-old trade passed downhanded from one generation to the next within a family or community代代傳承 through generations is being quietly reinvented in a university laboratory. Chan Kwok-leung, a sixth-generation farmer known locally as Brother Leung, has spent the past decade confronting a problem no amount of traditional skill could solve on its own: annual oyster die-offsevents in which large numbers of a species die at the same time蠔隻大量死亡 that farmers say can wipe out as much as 80 percent of a season's stock, driven by warmer, saltier water and shrinking breeding grounds.

Researchers at the University of Hong Kong believe part of the answer lies in genetics rather than technique. Using genomic selectiona breeding method that uses genetic data to predict and choose the hardiest individuals基因組選育, scientists have bred what they call the “HKU Super Oyster”, a strain engineereddeliberately designed or developed to have specific, useful qualities改良培育 to tolerate high-salinity conditions at roughly three to four times the survival rate of ordinary local oysters. Early trials are under way on farmers' rafts, though growers caution that judging the strain's true resiliencethe ability to survive and recover from difficult or harsh conditions抗逆能力 will take at least a full year, since oysters raised from lab-selected seed must still survive an entire natural growing cycle before anyone can call the experiment a success.

For Lau Fau Shan, where the number of working oyster farms has dwindled for decades, the stakes extend well beyond one harvest. A trade once central to the area's livelihooda person's or community's means of earning the income needed to live生計 and identity now survives mostly as memory for many younger residents, and whether science can restore its viabilitybring something back to a state in which it can function and continue successfully挽回其可持續性 may determine if the 700-year-old industry becomes a living trade again or fades into a story told at food-heritage exhibitions rather than practised on the water.
articles.summary_zh_html:
在流浮山漁村——當地家庭養蠔的歷史已長達約七百年——一項代代傳承下來的古老行業，正悄悄在大學實驗室裡經歷一場重塑。第六代蠔農、本地人稱之為「良哥」的陳國樑，過去十年一直在設法解決一個單靠傳統技藝無法解決的問題：蠔農稱每年的蠔隻大量死亡情況，有時可令整季收成損失多達八成，原因包括水溫及鹽度上升，以及養殖場範圍日漸收窄。

香港大學的研究人員相信，部分答案在於基因，而非養殖技巧。科學家利用基因組選育技術，培育出所謂的「港大超級蠔」——一種經過改良培育、能在高鹽度環境下生存的品種，存活率約為本地普通蠔的三至四倍。相關品種現正在蠔農的養殖棚架上進行初步試養，但蠔農提醒，要判斷這個品種的真正抗逆能力，至少需要一整年時間，因為以實驗室篩選種苗養殖的蠔，仍須經歷完整的自然生長週期，才能判斷這次實驗是否成功。

對流浮山而言，隨著經營中的蠔場數目數十年來持續減少，這次嘗試的意義遠超一季收成。這個曾是當地生計與身份象徵核心的行業，對許多年輕居民而言，如今大多只剩記憶；科學能否成功挽回其可持續性，將會決定這個七百年歷史的行業，日後能否重新成為一門活生生的行業，還是只淪為美食文化展覽中被講述的故事，而非在水上真正被實踐的技藝。
articles.image_scene: A traditional stilt-house fishing village at the water's edge in Hong Kong's New Territories at golden-hour light, an anonymous weathered farmer in rolled-up trousers standing on a floating wooden raft stacked with mesh oyster bags, calm shallow water stretching toward distant hills, a few small sampans moored nearby, no readable signage or logos.

trends.headline: 🎭 Singapore Musician's 'Acting Hongkonger' Threads Challenge Goes Viral
trends.summary_html:
A short street-level video has turned a Singaporean musician's first Hong Kong trip since 2018 into one of this week's most-watched local clips. Visiting the city, Caleb Tay asked passers-by to coachto give someone guidance or training to help them improve a skill指導 him on how to convincingly pass asto be successfully accepted or mistaken as something one is not扮成 a local — tweaking his accent, posture and even the pace of his walk — in a playful experiment that quickly snowballedgrew rapidly in size, importance or intensity, like a snowball rolling downhill滾雪球式發展 into a full video series. The original clip alone has drawn more than 4.3 million views, while a straight-faced follow-up in which he tried out his new “Hongkonger” persona on unsuspecting strangers racked up a further 210,000-plus views, with commenters debating whether his impressionan imitation of someone's manner, voice or appearance, often for entertainment模仿 was flattering, funny, or faintly reductiveoversimplifying something complex to the point of distorting it流於表面.

Part of the clip's appeal lies in how ordinary Hongkongers became co-creatorspeople who jointly create or shape something, rather than simply being its subject共同創作者 rather than mere subjects, offering tips with evident local pride even as some viewers questioned whether reducing an entire city's identitythe qualities, beliefs and characteristics that define who a person or group is身份認同 to accent and mannerisms says more about outsiders' assumptions than about Hong Kong itself.
trends.summary_zh_html:
一段街頭短片，令一名新加坡音樂人自二零一八年以來首次訪港的旅程，成為本週全城最多人觀看的本地短片之一。Caleb Tay在港期間，邀請路人即場指導他如何令自己更能逼真地扮成一個本地人——從口音、站姿，甚至走路節奏都逐一調整——這個帶點玩味的實驗，很快便滾雪球式發展成一整個短片系列。單是最初那段短片，觀看次數已超過四百三十萬，而他後來板著臉、嘗試將新學會的「香港人」人格套用在不知情的陌生人身上的後續短片，亦額外吸引逾二十一萬次觀看，網民紛紛議論，他的模仿究竟是討好、搞笑，還是略嫌流於表面。

這段短片之所以吸引，部分原因在於普通香港人並非單純被觀察的對象，而是搖身一變成為共同創作者，他們帶著明顯的本地自豪感給予提點；不過，同時也有觀眾質疑，將整座城市的身份認同簡化成口音和舉止，是否其實反映更多的是外來者的想像，而非香港本身。

causes.label: Hong Kong identity reduced to a checklist of quirks
causes.label_zh: 香港身份被簡化成一張特徵清單
causes.text: The video's popularity suggests many Hongkongers enjoy seeing their everyday habits treated as distinctive and worth teaching, yet it also raises an uncomfortable question: if identity can be taught in a few viral clips, does that flatten decades of lived history, migration and class difference into a handful of easily imitated mannerisms?
causes.text_zh: 這段短片的爆紅，顯示不少香港人樂於看見自己日常習慣被視為獨特、值得傳授的事物，但同時亦帶出一個令人不安的問題：如果身份認同可以透過幾段爆紅短片教會別人，那是否正正把數十年的歷史、移民經歷與階層差異，簡化成幾個容易模仿的小動作？

causes.label: Unpaid, accidental tourism marketing for Hong Kong
causes.label_zh: 無心促成香港的免費旅遊宣傳
causes.text: A foreign visitor's playful street experiment did more to put Hong Kong's personality in front of millions of viewers than most official tourism campaigns manage in months, hinting that authentic, unscripted content from ordinary residents may now market a city's charm more effectively than any paid advertisement ever could.
causes.text_zh: 一名外國遊客的街頭玩味實驗，在短時間內讓數以百萬計的觀眾看見香港的個性，效果勝過大多數官方旅遊宣傳在數月內所能達到的成效，反映出由普通居民自發拍攝、未經設計的真實內容，如今或比任何付費廣告更能有效推廣一座城市的魅力。

causes.label: Locals as co-authors, not passive punchlines
causes.label_zh: 本地人成為共同創作者，而非被動的笑料
causes.text: Unlike older, more condescending depictions of locals as comic props, this trend put ordinary Hongkongers directly in charge of defining their own image, coaching a stranger with evident pride rather than simply being filmed and mocked, which may explain why so many engaged warmly rather than defensively.
causes.text_zh: 與昔日那些把本地人塑造成笑料、帶點輕視意味的描繪不同，這次潮流讓普通香港人親自主導自己的形象，他們帶著明顯的自豪感去指導一名外來者，而非單純被拍攝和取笑，這或許解釋了為何這麼多人是帶著善意、而非防衛心態去參與其中。

causes.label: A charming clip is not the same as genuine cultural understanding
causes.label_zh: 一段有趣的短片，不等於真正的文化理解
causes.text: However warmly it was received, a few minutes of coached mannerisms cannot substitute for understanding a city's history, pressures or divisions, and treating virality itself as proof of successful cultural exchange risks mistaking a pleasant performance for something deeper that it never actually achieved.
causes.text_zh: 儘管這段短片備受歡迎，幾分鐘經過指導的言行舉止，始終無法取代對一座城市歷史、壓力與分歧的真正理解；若將爆紅本身視為文化交流成功的證明，便有可能把一次愉快的表演，誤當成一件它從未真正達成的更深層事情。
